seo.title: Meet the team — Modern Cabinets
seo.description: The designers, cabinetmakers and installers behind Modern Cabinets. Licensed, family owned, and building glide-out shelving across the Phoenix valley since 2009.

sections.heading: Meet the team behind Modern Cabinets.
sections.body: Licensed cabinetmakers, seasoned installers, and a support crew who treat every job like it is their own home. Get to know the people building your shelving across the Phoenix valley.

sections.heading: The people powering your service.
sections.intro: Designers, cabinetmakers, and office staff who show up on time and stand behind the work. Add each person's photo in Site Settings.

members.name: Marcus Reyes
members.bio: 18 years in the trade. Founded the company on a simple promise: do every job right.

members.name: Daniela Cruz
members.bio: Runs scheduling, dispatch, and quality control across the entire crew.

members.name: Tyrone Walker
members.bio: Specialises in glide-out retrofits and awkward corner cabinets. Eight years with the team.

members.name: Priya Anand
members.bio: Measures on site and turns a wish list into a shelf-by-shelf plan you can read.

members.name: Jamal Foster
members.bio: Cuts and finishes every shelf to the sixteenth in the shop before it ever reaches your kitchen.

members.name: Sophia Nguyen
members.bio: The friendly voice on the phone, scheduling appointments and keeping every visit on track.

sections.heading: Want to build with us?
sections.body: We are always looking for skilled cabinetmakers, installers, and support staff who share our standards. Fair pay, steady work, and a real trade to grow in.
